config_fields.name: adzone_id
config_fields.help: Promotion slot id: the last number of your 淘宝联盟 PID mm_xxx_xxx_<adzone_id> (pub.alimama.com > 推广管理 > 推广位管理).

fields.name: app_key
fields.help: AppKey of your Taobao Open Platform (TOP) application (open.taobao.com console).

fields.name: app_secret
fields.help: AppSecret of the same application; signs every call as upper-case MD5(secret + parameters sorted by name as name+value + secret) and is never sent.

me.note: taobao.time.get: Taobao server time; a signed call that verifies the app_key/app_secret pair.

list_products.note: 淘宝联盟 taobao.tbk.dg.material.optional.upgrade (物料搜索升级版): keyword (`query`) or category (`category`, comma-separated backend cids) search of promotable Taobao/Tmall items for your adzone; price = current selling price (zk_final_price), final_price = estimated price after coupons, url = your promotion click_url, income_rate = commission + subsidy %. `id` is the new-style 淘宝客 item id.

get_product.note: 淘宝联盟 taobao.tbk.item.info.get (简版): one item's title, list price (reserve_price), selling price (zk_final_price), images, shop, 30-day sales and location.

not_offered.quote_shipping: 淘宝联盟 promoters do not buy: the 淘宝客 APIs (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=64759&docType=2) return promotion links and at most a real_post_fee estimate; freight is quoted by the seller at checkout on Taobao.
not_offered.create_order: Orders are placed by the buyer on Taobao through the promotion link; no 淘宝客 API creates orders (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=43328&docType=2 only reports them). Distributor purchase orders of the 供销平台 need a per-member session from the distributor's ISV authorisation.
not_offered.get_order: taobao.tbk.order.details.get (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=43328&docType=2) queries promoted orders only by time window (start_time/end_time ≤ 3 h apart), not by order id.
not_offered.track: No logistics API exists for 淘宝客 promoters (https://open.taobao.com/api.htm?docId=43328&docType=2); shipments belong to the buyer's Taobao order.

adapter.terms: Taobao Open Platform calling convention (https://open.taobao.com/doc.htm?docId=101617&docType=1): md5 signature over all parameters, timestamp in GMT+8. 淘宝联盟 APIs need an app of type 联盟合作网站/APP and a registered adzone; commissions follow 淘宝联盟 rules.

live_check.notes: requires app_key, app_secret, adzone_id; started, listed tools and answered a clean auth_error naming the variables
